label: <DEL> delimiter step (plus early first-occurrence 0/u/2/e inputs)
explanation: Fires mainly on the <DEL> delimiter step (78% of activation mass; active on about 42% of delimiters, more often for short L: 19% of steps at L=3 vs 3% at L=9). A weaker secondary component fires at original positions t<=2 when the input is the first occurrence of 0, u, 2 or e (22% of mass). Never fires in the copy phase and almost never on repeated tokens. Which delimiters fire is content-dependent and not cleanly captured: the strongest activations (max 0.18) come on sequences that start with i or l and whose last original token is v/1/j/t, but restricting by first token or L did not improve F1 much. The predicate has near-complete mass recall (0.98) but precision is only about 0.44 because many delimiter steps stay silent.
